projects.title: GovShield BD
projects.outcome: Detects fake and lookalike Bangladesh government websites before citizens are phished.
projects.problem: Lookalike government portals trick citizens into submitting personal data and payments to fraudulent sites. No automated early-warning system existed for Bangladesh's government domain space.
projects.approach: Built a 12-module detection pipeline: CT log monitoring ingests new certificate registrations in near-real-time, a visual similarity engine compares screenshots against known-good government pages, and an incident response module flags confirmed fakes for human review.
keyFeatures: Certificate Transparency log monitoring for .bd domains
Visual similarity engine using perceptual hashing
IOC management and incident response workflow

testingStrategy.coverageNote: Critical detection paths covered end-to-end; API contract tests run in CI.
testingStrategy.bugsFound: Integration test caught a timing bug where CT log entries were ingested before the similarity engine was ready, causing silent drops. Added a queue-based handoff with retry.

projects.improvements: Add ML-based URL structure analysis to catch IDN homograph attacks; move visual engine to a GPU-backed worker.

projects.title: Bangladesh News Monitor
projects.outcome: Scrapes, categorises and surfaces Bangladeshi news in real time with Telegram alerts.
projects.problem: No single dashboard aggregates news from Bangladesh's fragmented media landscape with automatic topic tagging.
projects.approach: Scraper layer pulls from major outlets on a cron schedule. An AI categoriser tags articles by topic. A React dashboard renders a filterable feed. Telegram bot delivers breaking-news alerts on configurable keywords.
keyFeatures: Fully Dockerised — one command to run

testingStrategy.coverageNote: Scraper tests snapshot expected article structure; failures surface selector drift quickly.
testingStrategy.bugsFound: Unit test caught a categoriser edge-case where articles with no body text caused a division-by-zero in the TF-IDF scorer.

projects.improvements: Add multilingual support for Bangla articles; replace polling-based ingestion with WebSocket-based push from supported outlets.

projects.title: GeoInsight BD
projects.outcome: Geospatial analytics platform for Bangladesh with time-series data, message queues and object storage.
projects.problem: Geospatial time-series data for Bangladesh (weather, traffic, environmental sensors) has no unified analytics layer accessible to researchers and NGOs.
projects.approach: Node.js API gateway routes ingest requests to a Python analytics service via RabbitMQ. TimescaleDB stores hypertables for efficient time-range queries. MinIO stores raw data files and generated map tiles. Next.js dashboard visualises the data.
keyFeatures: TimescaleDB hypertables for time-series geospatial data
Redis caching layer for hot queries
MinIO object storage for raw datasets

testingStrategy.coverageNote: JMeter load tests validate time-range query performance under concurrent reads.
testingStrategy.bugsFound: Load test revealed Redis cache invalidation was not scoped per-tenant, causing one user's stale cache to be served to another during concurrent requests.

projects.improvements: Kubernetes orchestration; streaming ingest via Kafka for real-time sensor feeds.
